title: Failed provider calls cannot mint investigation progress

regression.scenario: runLocalCliCampaign with a fake provider that always exits 1

observed.actionCount: equals providerFailures (every recorded action is a failed reasoner call)
observed.toolActions: none; the checkpoint action log contains zero CALL_TOOL records

validityRule: classifyRunProviderOutcome returns PROVIDER_BLOCKED whenever validProviderResponses, providerResponseBytes, or sourceActions is not positive; a zero-progress failing provider can never be reported as a valid zero-yield run.
